exceptions.detail: The National Map reports 80 intersecting 1 m DEM products; the exact set has not been downloaded and checksum-pinned.
No complete, checksum-pinned NAIP scene manifest exists, and NAIP alone is below hero-facade texture density.
Required game-ready landmark models have not passed per-item provenance and redistribution review.
CTA data cannot be used for a general game-world package under its published limited-purpose license; use broadly licensed geometry or obtain written permission.
No OGC 3D Tiles, collision, navigation, KTX2, SBOM, signature, or visual/performance evidence has been generated.
CDN credentials, signing identity, two-person approvals, and named physical-GPU benchmark hardware are unavailable.
